thread:
lexi: quick question — my parental office in Spain observes Epiphany (Jan 6) as a public holiday, but company year-end blackout lists Jan 4-8 as restricted for time-off approvals. Im due to fly back on Jan 5. Can I swap that Spanish public holiday into a floating day instead?

nate-people-ops: hey lexi :wave: good catch. Short version: we try to honor local public holidays but blackouts for year-end staffing take precedence. We allow swaps in some cases with manager + local HR sign-off. Do you have a manager note?

lexi: sarah approved coverage, but marta in EU HR asked if payroll needs a different classification for cross-country holidays.

marta-hr-eu: correct — for EU offices we can mark Jan 6 as a local public holiday, but if the global blackout blocks approvals we offer a floating day or unpaid day alternative. Floating day is preferred when coverage exists. Please confirm timezone and flight date so we can record it.

lexi: flight returns 2025-01-05 18:30 CET. Manager said coverage is okay. I'd like a floating day swap for Jan 6.

ben-payroll: tagging payroll notes: 1) floating day swap must be added before payroll cutoff (2024-12-22) to appear in year-end balances. 2) If the original holiday was in a different payroll jurisdiction we recalculate tax/benefit reporting for that pay period. 3) We record swaps as: `swap_date=2025-01-06, reason=local-holiday, approved_by=sarah, hr=marta`.

hr-bot: checklist created: [ ] manager approval uploaded, [ ] HR sign-off, [ ] payroll form filed. Link: https://hr.internal/pto-swap-form

nate-people-ops: next steps: lexi uploads approval note + picks floating vs unpaid in the form. Marta will sign once payroll implications acknowledged. We'll aim to keep your 2024 PTO balance intact if we get this in time. :white_check_mark:

lexi: done — uploaded manager note and picked floating day. Thanks all! :pray:

marta-hr-eu: signed off. Ben, you good to proceed with payroll entry?

ben-payroll: got it. I'll queue the swap and confirm with lexI via DM once processed. Expect confirmation by 2024-12-20.

lexi: appreciate it. Saved me from losing that day. :relieved:
